title: 第5章 异界的战争第6章 我只相信人民的子弟兵
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: “该死的魔族又来了！”
芬朵娜恨恨地丢下一句，整个人化作一阵风，抓起法杖就朝露台外冲去。
“芬朵娜殿下，危险！”一名卫兵伸手去拦，指尖只擦过一缕残影。
“我的族人正在流血，我不能眼睁睁看着！”
芬朵娜的声音远远传来。
剩下的精灵卫兵对视一眼，也顾不上林默这个画风清奇的异界来客，齐刷刷地化作绿影追了出去。
眨眼间，华丽的树屋里只剩下林默一个。
“诶！等等！”
林默冲着空荡荡的门口大喊。
没人搭理他。
“我都已经证明了，倒是给我解开啊！”
忽然他感觉脚踝处一松。
捆着他的藤蔓扭动了一下，自动缩回了地板的缝隙里。
林默心中一喜，赶紧揉着发麻的脚踝，一秒钟都没耽搁，拔腿就往露台冲。
他需要趁此机会了解这个神奇世界。
至于逃跑，人生地不熟的，能往哪逃？
从那号角声和紧张的气氛判断，这绝对是正在发生战争。
这个有魔法、有世界树的神奇地方，说不定是蓝星的救命稻草。
他得搞清楚，这是在和谁打仗。
敌人又有多强？
他可不想自己后面死的不明不白的。
林默一脚踏出树屋，踩上连接巨大树枝的悬空廊桥，然后整个人就被眼前景象再次惊呆。
这是一座完全建立在参天巨树之上的精灵城市！
无数活体藤蔓编织成的廊桥在几百米的高空纵横交错，连接着一个个精致的树屋。
奇花异草在阳光的照射下，美轮美奂。
无数精灵在廊桥上飞速穿行，身影矫健，每个人的脸上都挂着风雨欲来的肃杀。
他的视线越过廊桥，投向更远处。
世界树。
此刻，他才真正看清了它的主体。
树冠根本看不到顶，直接捅进了云层。
无数建筑群沿着粗壮的树干盘旋而上，点点灯火闪烁，宛如神国。
林默脑子里瞬间闪过大夏正在疯狂建设的“方舟”计划。
钢铁地堡，混凝土牢笼，头顶是永恒的岩层，呼吸着过滤循环的空气。
与眼前的相比，那是苟活。
content_en:
"The damn demons are here again!"
Fenduona said something bitterly, her whole body turned into a gust of wind, grabbed the staff and rushed out of the terrace.
"Your Highness Fendona, it's dangerous!" A guard stretched out his hand to stop her, but his fingertips only brushed an afterimage.
"My people are bleeding, I can't just watch!"
Fenduona's voice came from far away.
The remaining elf guards looked at each other and ignored Lin Mo, a visitor from another world with a strange painting style. They all turned into green shadows and chased him out.
In the blink of an eye, only Lin Mo was left in the gorgeous tree house.
"Hey! Wait!"
Lin Mo shouted towards the empty door.
No one paid any attention to him.
"I have already proved it, so please untie it for me!"
Suddenly he felt a looseness in his ankle.
The vines that tied him twisted and automatically retracted into the gap in the floor.
"Huh?"
Lin Mo was overjoyed and quickly rubbed his numb ankles. Without wasting a second, he rushed towards the terrace.
He needs to take this opportunity to learn about this amazing world.
As for escaping, where can a person who is unfamiliar with the place escape?
Judging from the sound of horns and the tense atmosphere, this was definitely a war.
This magical place with magic and the World Tree might be Blue Star's life-saving straw.
He had to figure out who he was fighting.
How strong is the enemy?
He didn't want to die inexplicably later.
Lin Mo stepped out of the tree house and stepped onto the suspended bridge connecting the huge branches. Then he was stunned again by the sight in front of him.
This is an elf city built entirely on towering trees!
Covered bridges woven by countless living vines crisscross hundreds of meters in the air, connecting each exquisite tree house.
The exotic flowers and plants are beautiful under the sunlight.
Countless elves were walking swiftly across the covered bridge, their figures strong and graceful, and everyone's face was filled with the solemn look of an approaching storm.
His gaze crossed the covered bridge and looked further into the distance.
World tree.
At this moment, he truly saw its main body.
The top of the tree crown cannot be seen at all, and it penetrates directly into the clouds.
Countless buildings circle up along the thick tree trunks, with lights twinkling, just like the kingdom of God.
Lin Mo's mind flashed to the "Ark" project that Daxia was building crazily.
Steel bunkers, concrete cages, eternal rock formations overhead, breathing filtered and recycled air.
Compared with what is in front of me, it is just a living.
